purpose: Archivist first-jump and weak-plateau procedure, with document-key grouping before cuts.
when_to_use: Use to cut a weak flat tail beyond the head cluster without an absolute cap.
how_to_adjust: Group document keys before selection. First jump uses upper median positive gap times 3 (minimum .02). With more than three remaining, head=median(first three), plateau delta=max(.02,2*arithmetic median positive gap); cut from index2 when distance>head+delta and local gap<.01. Optional d_max precedes analysis; top_k caps last. Repository/default-branch grouping remains module-owned.
